limitations: All seven records remain pending; evidence does not authenticate a human decision.
Research paper uses HKCanCor and retained tables can share upstream authorities; citations are not counted as independent speaker attestations.
No audio was downloaded or inspected, and no bulk web dictionary was harvested.
Noncommercial dictionary definitions/examples are references only and are outside selected default-source imports.
A separately published primary reference is not proof of independent data lineage. No independent recording or source-overlap exclusion is claimed.
method: Retained raw character/word tables first; generated phrase entries excluded from attestation. Word alignments are mechanical character-to-syllable matches, not a linguistic decomposition claim. Original corpus tokens/coordinates preserved. Primary web references then checked narrowly; absent table entries are not proof of impossible speech.
purpose: Evidence pack only; seven annotation/dictionary disagreements from the frozen HKCanCor evaluation. No import, label repair, approval, fitting or production change.

records.assessment: Corpus 蚚蜴 sik1 jik6 contrasts with retained 蜥蜴 sik1 jik6. LSHK/CUHK list 蚚 kei4 and 蜥 sik1; the MOE character dictionary defines 蚚 as a rice insect. This supports a possible written-character mismatch, but no checked primary source establishes 蚚 as a licensed variant of 蜥.

records.assessment: The same original turn has 脫骹/v/tyut3gaau3/ and 脫跤/v/tyut3gaau3/ in the injury discussion. CUHK/LSHK give 跤 gaau1 (also LSHK haau1), not gaau3. This is strong within-source orthographic inconsistency, not proof of a generic 跤 gaau3 reading or of a preferred correction.
records.suggested_review_question: Review the written variant in context; do not infer a global gaau1-to-gaau3 tone rule.

records.assessment: Source 三𠻺幾 saa1 aa6 gei2 describes thirty-something. Primary words.hk explicitly gives 卅 saa1 aa6 with 卅幾; CUHK gives 卅 saa1 as thirty, while 三 is saam1/saam3.
